faqSection.title: Server & Cloud Solutions
faqSection.subtitle: Answers to common questions regarding server deployment, DevOps automation, and cloud migrations.

items.question: Which public cloud platforms do you manage?
items.answer: We manage and deploy workloads across all three major public cloud providers: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

items.question: What is Infrastructure as Code (IaC)?
items.answer: Infrastructure as Code is the practice of managing and provisioning server environments through machine-readable configuration files (like Terraform or CloudFormation) rather than manual GUI setups, ensuring rapid and error-free deployments.

items.question: Can you migrate an on-premises physical server to the cloud?
items.answer: Yes. We perform full migrations of physical, bare-metal legacy servers and virtual machines (VMware/Hyper-V) to cloud platforms, planning database cutovers carefully to avoid business disruption.

items.question: How do you help optimize our monthly cloud bill?
items.answer: We audit your resources to find idle VM instances, downsize over-provisioned memory or storage, recommend reserved capacity plans, and set up auto-scaling policies that shut down resources when traffic decreases.

items.question: What is the difference between RTO and RPO in disaster recovery?
items.answer: RTO (Recovery Time Objective) is the maximum acceptable duration of downtime before recovery is complete. RPO (Recovery Point Objective) is the maximum age of files that must be recovered from backup storage for operations to resume.

items.question: How do we get started with your server and cloud services?
items.answer: Contact our engineering team using our online form. We will coordinate a discovery session to evaluate your workloads, estimate migration timescales, and design a custom virtualization strategy.
